component.name: Koha Offline Circulation
component.summary: Circulate items while the Koha server is unreachable

description.p: Scan patron cards and item barcodes for checkouts, returns, and fine payments while your Koha server is offline. Transactions are written to a .koc file that uploads to Koha once you are back online, either straight from the app or through the staff interface.
With a borrowers database downloaded from Koha, the app also shows patron details and searches for patrons by name while offline.
